evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A contrastive definition asserted as self-evident logic, performing persuasion through conceptual distinction rather than authority or appeal.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Semicolon-joined thesis supplies a factual framing (informational) and argues it through a commodity/asset distinction (rational-persuasion).
